rules.name: Requisitions
rules.text: An additional 250/500/750 points of eligible Requisitioned units can be added in 1,000/2,000/3,000-point battles. This additional allowance uses the shared Requisition roster; it does not unlock new datasheets.

rules.name: Supreme Authority
rules.text: At the start of your Command phase, if the WARLORD is on the battlefield, gain 1 additional AP.

rules.name: Unified Campaign
rules.text: At the start of your Command phase, select one directive below. Until the start of your next Command phase, it applies to friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM and REQUISITIONED models.

rules.name: Advance
rules.text: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of affected INFANTRY models.

rules.name: Exterminate
rules.text: Each time an affected model makes an attack targeting the Priority Target, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.

rules.name: Occupy
rules.text: While an affected model is within range of the Priority Site, add 1 to its Objective Control characteristic, unless that characteristic is 0.

enhancements.name: Seal of the Senatorum
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. Start the battle with 2 additional AP.

enhancements.name: Master of Retinues
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. The bearer's unit has Scouts 6".

enhancements.name: Strategic Conductor
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. Once per battle round, when the bearer's unit is selected as a target of a Stratagem, you can reduce the CP cost of that use by 1.

enhancements.name: Executioner's Seal
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack targeting the Priority Target, add 2 to the Strength characteristic and 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack, excluding attacks made with Extra Attacks weapons.

stratagems.name: Coordinated Execution
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.
TARGET: Two friendly units that have AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM or REQUISITIONED. The units must have different native branch keywords or different parent Faction keywords.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by each model in those units by 1 when targeting the Priority Target.

stratagems.name: Imperial Shieldwall
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets.
TARGET: One friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM or REQUISITIONED INFANTRY unit selected as a target.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to armour saving throws made for models in that unit.

stratagems.name: Overwhelming Authority
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase, after taking Battle-shock tests.
TARGET: One friendly Battle-shocked AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM or REQUISITIONED unit.
EFFECT: That unit is no longer Battle-shocked. Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in it, unless that characteristic is 0. This Stratagem can target a Battle-shocked unit.

stratagems.name: Coordinated Advance
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a friendly unit ends an Advance move.
TARGET: That AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM or REQUISITIONED INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge despite having Advanced.

stratagems.name: Contingency Orders
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
TARGET: One friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM or REQUISITIONED INFANTRY unit within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of enemy units.
EFFECT: That friendly unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Reassignment of Assets
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent's turn.
TARGET: One friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM or REQUISITIONED INFANTRY unit more than 8" horizontally from all enemy models.
EFFECT: Remove that unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

rules.name: Requisitions
rules.text: An additional 250/500/750 points of ADEPTA SORORITAS units can be added as Requisitions in 1,000/2,000/3,000-point battles, respectively. All non-CHARACTER ADEPTA SORORITAS datasheets can be Requisitioned. Requisitioned ADEPTA SORORITAS models gain ORDO HERETICUS.

rules.name: Purge the Unclean
rules.text: Ranged weapons equipped by INQUISITION, MINISTORUM, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO HERETICUS models have Ignores Cover. Each time one of those models makes a ranged attack targeting the Priority Target, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

writs.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That friendly INQUISITION, MINISTORUM, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO HERETICUS INFANTRY unit, if it is within 12" of this model. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by each INQUISITION, MINISTORUM, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO HERETICUS model in that unit. LIMIT: Once per battle round for this model.

writs.name: Writ of Zeal
writs.text: WHEN: The Fight phase, when a friendly unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That friendly INQUISITION, MINISTORUM, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO HERETICUS INFANTRY unit, if it is within 12" of this model. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by each model in that unit. LIMIT: Once per battle round for this model.

writs.name: Writ of Detainment
writs.text: WHEN: When an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back. TARGET: That enemy non-TITANIC unit, if it is within 12" of this model and within Engagement Range of a friendly INQUISITION, MINISTORUM, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO HERETICUS unit. EFFECT: That enemy unit cannot Fall Back this phase. Its controlling player must select another legal move type, or it must Remain Stationary. LIMIT: Once per battle round for this model.

TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, MINISTORUM, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO HERETICUS unit.

stratagems.name: Faith Against Fury
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, MINISTORUM, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO HERETICUS INFANTRY unit selected as a target.

stratagems.name: Relentless Purgation
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a friendly unit ends a Fall Back move.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, MINISTORUM, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO HERETICUS unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge despite having Fallen Back.

stratagems.name: Burn Them As They Flee
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, MINISTORUM, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO HERETICUS INFANTRY unit that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase and is eligible to shoot.
EFFECT: That friendly unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, targeting only the enemy unit that Fell Back. Resolve those attacks immediately, following normal range, visibility and targeting restrictions.

stratagems.name: The Martyrs' Sentence
stratagems.text:
WHEN: The Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, MINISTORUM, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO HERETICUS INFANTRY unit selected as a target.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit is destroyed by a melee attack, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove it yet. After the attacking unit has fought, that destroyed model can fight, then is removed. Each destroyed model can fight only once.

rules.name: Requisitions
rules.text: An additional 250/500/750 points of DEATHWATCH units can be added as Requisitions in 1,000/2,000/3,000-point battles, respectively. The Deathwatch-specific non-CHARACTER roster and its vehicles can be Requisitioned. This does not unlock the complete ADEPTUS ASTARTES roster. Requisitioned DEATHWATCH models gain ORDO XENOS.

rules.name: Forbidden Arsenal
rules.text: Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of weapons equipped by INQUISITION or ORDO XENOS models by 1.

rules.name: Xenological Analysis
rules.text: After a friendly INQUISITION unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more attacks made by INQUISITION models in that unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a friendly INQUISITION or ORDO XENOS model attacks that enemy unit, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack. If that enemy unit is also the Priority Target, you can re-roll Wound rolls of 1 for those attacks.

enhancements.name: Alien Hunter
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. Each time a model in the bearer's unit attacks the Priority Target, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Translocation Beacon
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. The bearer's unit has Deep Strike. Once per battle, when that unit is selected as a target of Rapid Ingress, reduce the CP cost of that use to 0.

enhancements.name: Xenophase Weapon
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic by 1 and add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons, excluding Extra Attacks weapons.

enhancements.name: Veterans of Alien Wars
enhancements.text: Non-CHARACTER INQUISITION or ORDO XENOS INFANTRY unit. / UPGRADE This unit has Scouts 6".

writs.name: Writ of Adaptation
writs.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That friendly INQUISITION or ORDO XENOS INFANTRY unit within 12" of this model. EFFECT: Select Anti-Infantry 4+, Anti-Monster 5+ or Anti-Vehicle 5+. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by each INQUISITION or ORDO XENOS model in that unit have that ability. Weapons with Devastating Wounds are eligible. LIMIT: Once per battle round for this model.

writs.name: Writ of Evasion
writs.text: WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move. TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION or ORDO XENOS INFANTRY unit within 12" of this model and within 8" of that enemy unit, if it is not within Engagement Range of enemy units. EFFECT: That friendly unit can make a Normal move of up to 6". LIMIT: Once per battle round for this model.

writs.name: Writ of Penetration
writs.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That friendly INQUISITION or ORDO XENOS INFANTRY unit within 12" of this model. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an INQUISITION or ORDO XENOS model in that unit makes a ranged attack targeting a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, that attack has Ignores Cover and its Armour Penetration characteristic is improved by 1. LIMIT: Once per battle round for this model.

stratagems.name: Adaptive Rearmament
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION or ORDO XENOS unit.
EFFECT: Select Lethal Hits or Sustained Hits 1. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by each INQUISITION or ORDO XENOS model in that unit have that ability.

stratagems.name: Surgical Interdiction
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION or ORDO XENOS unit.
EFFECT: After that unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by its attacks. Until the end of the turn, that enemy unit cannot be selected as a target of Fire Overwatch or Heroic Intervention.

stratagems.name: Hunter's Reposition
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after a friendly unit has shot.
TARGET: That friendly INQUISITION or ORDO XENOS INFANTRY unit, if it is not within Engagement Range of enemy units.
EFFECT: That unit can make a Normal move of up to 6". It cannot declare a charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Experimental Ammunition
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION or ORDO XENOS unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Range characteristic and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic by 1 of ranged weapons equipped by each INQUISITION or ORDO XENOS model in that unit.

stratagems.name: Cut Down the Quarry
stratagems.text:
WHEN: The Fight phase, when a friendly unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION or ORDO XENOS unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an INQUISITION or ORDO XENOS model in that unit makes an attack targeting the Priority Target, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Return To the Conclave
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent's turn.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION or ORDO XENOS INFANTRY unit not within Engagement Range of enemy units.
EFFECT: Remove that unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. Until the end of your next Movement phase, that unit has Deep Strike.

rules.name: Requisitions
rules.text: An additional 250/500/750 points of GREY KNIGHTS units can be added as Requisitions in 1,000/2,000/3,000-point battles, respectively. All non-CHARACTER GREY KNIGHTS datasheets can be Requisitioned. Non-CHARACTER Sisters of Silence units and their transport can also be Requisitioned using the shared allowance; this additional allowance is for GREY KNIGHTS only. Requisitioned GREY KNIGHTS models gain ORDO MALLEUS.

rules.name: The Emperor's Aegis
rules.text: Each time an attack targets a friendly INQUISITION, ORDO MALLEUS or ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

rules.name: Daemon Slayers
rules.text: Each time an INQUISITION, ORDO MALLEUS or ANATHEMA PSYKANA model attacks the Priority Target, you can re-roll a Wound roll of 1. Each time such a model attacks a DAEMON or PSYKER unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead. Each time such a model makes a melee attack targeting the Priority Target or an enemy unit within range of the Priority Site, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Liber Daemonica
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. Add 1 to the Strength characteristic and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic by 1 of Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Sigil of Exigence
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. Once per battle, in your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects the bearer's unit as a target, remove the bearer's unit from the battlefield and set it up again anywhere more than 8" horizontally from all enemy models. That enemy unit can select new targets. This relocation does not make the bearer's unit count as having arrived from Reserves.

enhancements.name: Cuirass of Sacrifice
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. Add 1 to the bearer's Toughness characteristic and 2 to its Wounds characteristic.

enhancements.name: Consecrated Harness
enhancements.text: Non-CHARACTER INQUISITION, ORDO MALLEUS or ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit. / UPGRADE You can ignore any or all modifiers to the Move characteristics of models in this unit and to Advance and Charge rolls made for it.

writs.name: Writ of Anathema
writs.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot or fight. TARGET: That friendly INQUISITION, ORDO MALLEUS or ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit within 12" of this model. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of weapons equipped by each INQUISITION, ORDO MALLEUS or ANATHEMA PSYKANA model in that unit. Those weapons also have Anti-Psyker 4+ and Anti-Daemon 4+. LIMIT: Once per battle round for this model.

writs.name: Writ of the Aegis
writs.text: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets. TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, ORDO MALLEUS or ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit within 12" of this model and selected as a target. EFFECT: Until that enemy unit has finished making its attacks, subtract 1 from Hit rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit. LIMIT: Once per battle round for this model.

writs.name: Writ of Severance
writs.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when this model's unit is selected to shoot or fight. TARGET: This model's unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, enemy models cannot use Feel No Pain against attacks made by models in this unit. LIMIT: Once per battle round for this model.

stratagems.name: Truesilver Aegis
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, ORDO MALLEUS or ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit selected as a target.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of attacks that target that unit by 1.

stratagems.name: Sanctioned Teleportation
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent's turn.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, ORDO MALLEUS or ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit not within Engagement Range of enemy units.
EFFECT: Remove that unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. Until the end of your next Movement phase, it has Deep Strike.

stratagems.name: Hammer Blow
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a friendly unit ends a Charge move.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, ORDO MALLEUS or ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, add 1 to Wound rolls for melee attacks made by INQUISITION, ORDO MALLEUS or ANATHEMA PSYKANA models in that unit.

stratagems.name: Psychic Confluence
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, ORDO MALLEUS or ANATHEMA PSYKANA PSYKER INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of Psychic ranged weapons equipped by each INQUISITION or ORDO MALLEUS model in that unit.

stratagems.name: Ritual of Binding
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your Shooting phase.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, ORDO MALLEUS or ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit that hit an enemy unit with a Psychic attack this phase.
EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by one of those Psychic attacks. Until the end of its next Movement phase, that enemy unit cannot Advance.

stratagems.name: Counter-Incursion
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up from Reserves.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, ORDO MALLEUS or ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit within 12" of that enemy unit and eligible to shoot.
EFFECT: That friendly unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, targeting only that enemy unit and following normal targeting restrictions.

rules.name: Requisitions
rules.text: An additional 250/500/750 points of ASTRA MILITARUM units can be added as Requisitions in 1,000/2,000/3,000-point battles, respectively. Non-TITANIC, non-CHARACTER ASTRA MILITARUM units and non-EPIC HERO ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER units can be Requisitioned. Requisitioned ASTRA MILITARUM models gain ORDO MILITARUM.

rules.name: Coordinated Fire Plan
rules.text: After a friendly INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO MILITARUM unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by an attack made by an INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO MILITARUM model in that unit. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to Hit rolls for ranged attacks made by friendly INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO MILITARUM models that target that enemy unit.

enhancements.name: Munitorum Mandate
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER or Requisitioned ORDO MILITARUM CHARACTER model. Add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in the bearer's unit, unless that characteristic is 0.

enhancements.name: Forward Observer
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER or Requisitioned ORDO MILITARUM CHARACTER model. After the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by its attacks. Until the end of the phase, ranged attacks made by friendly INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO MILITARUM models that target that unit have Ignores Cover.

writs.name: Writ of Mobilisation
writs.text: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly unit is selected to move. TARGET: That friendly INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO MILITARUM INFANTRY unit within 12" of this model. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit. That unit is eligible to shoot and start an Action despite having Advanced. LIMIT: Once per battle round for this model.

stratagems.name: Concentrated Fire
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO MILITARUM unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by each INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO MILITARUM model in that unit.

stratagems.name: Entrenched Defence
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO MILITARUM INFANTRY unit selected as a target.
EFFECT: Until that enemy unit has finished making its attacks, add 1 to armour saving throws made for models in that friendly unit.

stratagems.name: Tactical Withdrawal
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a friendly unit ends a Fall Back move.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO MILITARUM unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge despite having Fallen Back.

rules.name: Requisitions
rules.text: An additional 250/500/750 points of ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units can be added as Requisitions in 1,000/2,000/3,000-point battles, respectively. Non-TITANIC, non-CHARACTER ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units and non-EPIC HERO TECH-PRIEST units can be Requisitioned. Requisitioned ADEPTUS MECHANICUS models gain ORDO MACHINUM.

rules.name: Sanctioned Calibration
rules.text: Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by INQUISITION models, ORDO MACHINUM models and native AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM VEHICLE models. Each time a friendly unit containing any of those models is selected to shoot, you can re-roll one Hit roll and one Wound roll made for one of those models during that shooting activation.

enhancements.name: Omnissian Relic
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER or Requisitioned ORDO MACHINUM TECH-PRIEST model. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit have Ignores Cover.

enhancements.name: Sanctioned Cybernetics
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER or Requisitioned ORDO MACHINUM TECH-PRIEST model. Add 1 to the bearer's Toughness and Wounds characteristics.

writs.name: Writ of Disassembly
writs.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That friendly INQUISITION, ORDO MACHINUM or native AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM VEHICLE unit within 12" of this model. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by each INQUISITION, ORDO MACHINUM or native AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM VEHICLE model in that unit have Anti-Vehicle 4+. LIMIT: Once per battle round for this model.

stratagems.name: Overclocked Firepower
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, ORDO MACHINUM or native AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM VEHICLE unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by each INQUISITION, ORDO MACHINUM or native AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM VEHICLE model in that unit. Those weapons also have Hazardous.

stratagems.name: Machine Interference
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy VEHICLE unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITOR or TECH-PRIEST model that can see that enemy unit.
EFFECT: Until that enemy unit has finished making its attacks, subtract 1 from its Hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Emergency Restoration
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly native AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM VEHICLE or ORDO MACHINUM VEHICLE model within 12" of a friendly INQUISITOR or TECH-PRIEST model.
EFFECT: That VEHICLE model regains up to 3 lost wounds.

rules.name: Eradicate the Affliction
rules.text: Each time an INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or MINISTORUM model makes an attack, you can re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If the target is Below Half-strength, also add 1 to the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Veteran of Outbreaks
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. Models in the bearer's unit can ignore any or all modifiers to their Hit and Wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Hazmat Armour
enhancements.text: Non-CHARACTER INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or MINISTORUM INFANTRY unit. / UPGRADE Models in this unit have Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

writs.name: Writ of Quarantine
writs.text: WHEN: End of your Shooting phase. TARGET: One enemy unit hit by an attack made by an INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or MINISTORUM model this phase, if that unit is visible to this model. EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, models in that enemy unit cannot regain lost wounds and destroyed models cannot be returned to it. LIMIT: Once per battle round for this model.

stratagems.name: Sterilise the Site
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or MINISTORUM unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by each INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or MINISTORUM model in that unit have Ignores Cover and add 1 to their Strength characteristics.

stratagems.name: Contain the Outbreak
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or MINISTORUM INFANTRY unit within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
EFFECT: That enemy unit must use the Desperate Escape mode for that Fall Back move. If it is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from its hazard rolls.

stratagems.name: Field Treatment
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or MINISTORUM INFANTRY unit below its Starting Strength.
EFFECT: Select one option: return up to D3+3 destroyed non-CHARACTER models with a starting Wounds characteristic of 1; return up to D3 destroyed non-CHARACTER models with a starting Wounds characteristic of 2; or return one destroyed non-CHARACTER model with a starting Wounds characteristic of 3 or more. Return the selected models at full wounds, following normal rules for returning models.

rules.name: Requisitions
rules.text: An additional 250/500/750 points of ADEPTUS ASTARTES units can be added as Requisitions in 1,000/2,000/3,000-point battles, respectively. Only these ADEPTUS ASTARTES datasheets are unlocked: Intercessor Squad; Assault Intercessor Squad; Heavy Intercessor Squad; Scout Squad; Sternguard Veteran Squad; Assault Intercessors with Jump Packs; Vanguard Veterans with Jump Packs; Bladeguard Veteran Squad; Company Heroes; Impulsor; Rhino. No other ADEPTUS ASTARTES datasheets are unlocked. Requisitioned ADEPTUS ASTARTES models gain ORDO ASTARTES.

rules.name: Arms of the Inquisition
rules.text: Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO ASTARTES models by 1. Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by INQUISITION models.

rules.name: Directed Intervention
rules.text: Each time an ORDO ASTARTES model makes a melee attack targeting an enemy unit hit by a friendly INQUISITION model earlier that turn, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.

rules.name: Company Liaison
rules.text: An INQUISITOR with Leader can lead a Requisitioned Company Heroes unit and satisfies its requirement for a CAPTAIN or CHAPTER MASTER. Requisitioned Rhinos can transport TACTICUS models; retain all other passenger restrictions and capacity costs.

enhancements.name: Chapter Liaison
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. The bearer's unit has Scouts 6".

enhancements.name: Relic of the Chapter
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. The bearer's melee weapons have Precision. Add 1 to their Damage characteristic, excluding Extra Attacks weapons.

writs.name: Writ of Intervention
writs.text: WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly unit declares a charge. TARGET: That friendly INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO ASTARTES INFANTRY unit within 12" of this model. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to Charge rolls made for that unit, and you can re-roll those Charge rolls. LIMIT: Once per battle round for this model.

stratagems.name: Transport Assault
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a friendly unit disembarks from a TRANSPORT that made a Normal move this phase.
TARGET: That friendly INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: That unit is eligible to declare a charge this turn despite having disembarked after its TRANSPORT made a Normal move.

stratagems.name: Relentless Advance
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a friendly unit ends an Advance move.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO ASTARTES unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge despite having Advanced.

stratagems.name: Armoured Brotherhood
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or ORDO ASTARTES unit selected as a target.
EFFECT: Until that enemy unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of attacks that target that friendly unit by 1.

rules.name: Foreseen Outcomes
rules.text: At the start of your Command phase, roll three D6 and retain the results until the start of your next Command phase. Once per phase, before making an Advance or Charge roll for a friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit, you can replace one D6 of that roll with one retained result. Roll any remaining dice normally. Expend the retained result after using it. A replaced die cannot be re-rolled; an unused result is lost when new dice are rolled.

enhancements.name: Chronometric Familiar
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. While the bearer is on the battlefield, roll four dice for Foreseen Outcomes instead of three.

enhancements.name: Paradox Ward
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. Once per battle, just after the bearer fails a saving throw, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

writs.name: Writ of Recurrence
writs.text: WHEN: Just after a friendly unit uses a retained Foreseen Outcomes result. TARGET: That friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit within 12" of this model. EFFECT: Retain that result instead of expending it. LIMIT: Once per battle round for this model.

stratagems.name: Temporal Displacement
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
TARGET: One friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of enemy units.
EFFECT: That friendly unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Foreseen Strike
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just before making a Hit or Wound roll for a friendly model.
TARGET: The AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit containing that model.
EFFECT: Treat that one Hit or Wound roll as an unmodified 6 instead of rolling it.

stratagems.name: Stolen Initiative
stratagems.text:
WHEN: The Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought.
TARGET: One friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit within Engagement Range of enemy units that has not fought this phase.
EFFECT: That friendly unit fights next.

rules.name: Directed Execution
rules.text: Each time an INQUISITION, ASSASSINORUM, DEATH CULT ASSASSINS, ARBITES MARKSMEN or ARBITES INTELLIGENCER model attacks a CHARACTER unit, that attack has Precision and you can re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Handler's Rosette
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model with an Imperial Sanction. Add 6" to ranges specified by Imperial Sanctions used by the bearer. This does not increase weapon ranges or the range of other abilities.

enhancements.name: Embedded Operatives
enhancements.text: Non-CHARACTER AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit. / UPGRADE This unit has Infiltrators.

writs.name: Writ of Execution
writs.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot or fight. TARGET: That friendly INQUISITION, ASSASSINORUM, DEATH CULT ASSASSINS, ARBITES MARKSMEN or ARBITES INTELLIGENCER INFANTRY unit within 12" of this model. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an INQUISITION, ASSASSINORUM, DEATH CULT ASSASSINS, ARBITES MARKSMEN or ARBITES INTELLIGENCER model in that unit makes an attack allocated to a CHARACTER model, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack. LIMIT: Once per battle round for this model.

stratagems.name: Expose Their Defences
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITOR model.
EFFECT: Select one enemy unit visible to that model. Until the end of the phase, ranged attacks made by friendly INQUISITION, ASSASSINORUM, DEATH CULT ASSASSINS, ARBITES MARKSMEN or ARBITES INTELLIGENCER models that target that enemy unit have Ignores Cover.

stratagems.name: Covered Extraction
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent's turn.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, ASSASSINORUM, DEATH CULT ASSASSINS, ARBITES MARKSMEN or ARBITES INTELLIGENCER INFANTRY unit not within Engagement Range of enemy units.
EFFECT: Remove that unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. Until the end of your next Movement phase, that unit has Deep Strike.

stratagems.name: No Witnesses
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot or fight.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, ASSASSINORUM, DEATH CULT ASSASSINS, ARBITES MARKSMEN or ARBITES INTELLIGENCER unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an INQUISITION, ASSASSINORUM, DEATH CULT ASSASSINS, ARBITES MARKSMEN or ARBITES INTELLIGENCER model in that unit attacks an enemy unit below its Starting Strength, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

rules.name: Jurisdiction Established
rules.text: Each time an ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITION or VOIDFARERS model attacks an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, add 1 to the Hit roll. While an ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITION or VOIDFARERS INFANTRY model is within range of an objective marker controlled by your army, add 1 to its Objective Control characteristic, unless that characteristic is 0.

enhancements.name: Marshal of the Cordon
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. The bearer's unit has Scouts 6".

enhancements.name: Seized Armoury
enhancements.text: Non-CHARACTER ADEPTUS ARBITES INFANTRY unit. / UPGRADE Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have Ignores Cover.

stratagems.name: Hold the Line
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITION or VOIDFARERS INFANTRY unit selected as a target.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to armour saving throws made for models in that friendly unit.

stratagems.name: Suppressive Enforcement
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after a friendly unit has shot.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITION or VOIDFARERS unit.
EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by an attack made by an ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITION or VOIDFARERS model in that unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit cannot start an Action.

stratagems.name: Rapid Response
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITION or VOIDFARERS INFANTRY unit not within Engagement Range of enemy units.
EFFECT: That unit can make a Normal move of up to 6". It must end that move within range of an objective marker.

rules.name: Extremis Sanction
rules.text: Limited-use abilities listed in the Temple register can be used twice per battle instead of once. Unless an entry is a pre-battle ability, it can be used no more than once per battle round. One Shot weapons listed in that register can be fired twice per battle instead of once.

rules.name: Temple Requisitions
rules.text: Each ASSASSINORUM model can purchase its named Temple package from the register, in addition to its datasheet points cost. These packages are part of this Detachment rule, not Enhancements, and do not use Enhancement selections. Other abilities retain their printed use limits.

enhancements.name: Embedded Handler
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. While the bearer is the only model in its unit, it has Lone Operative and Stealth.

enhancements.name: Concealed Approach
enhancements.text: Non-CHARACTER AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit. / UPGRADE This unit has Scouts 6".

stratagems.name: Prime Target
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot or fight.
TARGET: One friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM model in that unit attacks a CHARACTER unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll. ASSASSINORUM models in that unit can re-roll the Wound roll against any target.

stratagems.name: Orbital Oversight
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets.
TARGET: One friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit selected as a target.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in that unit can be selected as targets of ranged attacks only if the attacking model is within 18" of that unit, or within 6" if that unit has Lone Operative. The triggering enemy unit can select new targets. After that enemy unit has shot, if the friendly unit survives and is not within Engagement Range of enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Hyperstimms
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets.
TARGET: One friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER unit selected as a target.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in that unit. EVERSOR ASSASSIN models in it also have Feel No Pain 4+.

stratagems.name: Blind Grenades
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares its charge targets and before its Charge roll.
TARGET: One friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit declared as a target, if it is not within Engagement Range of enemy units.
EFFECT: Subtract 1 from that Charge roll, or subtract 2 if the friendly unit contains a VINDICARE ASSASSIN model. Until the end of your next turn, that friendly unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge despite having Fallen Back.

stratagems.name: Will-Sapping Salvo
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: One friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by each AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM model in that unit have Sustained Hits 1. The Damage characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by CULEXUS ASSASSIN models in that unit is 3.

stratagems.name: Ensnaring Trap
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent's Charge phase.
TARGET: One friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit eligible to declare a charge against one or more enemy units within 6" of it.
EFFECT: That unit can declare a charge against one or more eligible enemy units within 6". It does not receive a Charge bonus this turn. Until the end of the turn, add 1 to Wound rolls for melee attacks made by CALLIDUS ASSASSIN models in that unit.

packages.name: Vindicare
packages.text:
EXTREMIS SANCTION: Shieldbreaker ammunition can be selected twice per battle. Hellfire and Turbo-penetrator remain once each.
Micromelta Rounds: The Exitus rifle has Anti-Monster 4+ and Anti-Vehicle 4+ for all of its attacks.

packages.name: Callidus
packages.text:
EXTREMIS SANCTION: Shadow of Deception can be used twice per battle, selecting a different Stratagem each time. A Word in Your Ear remains once per battle, in its pre-battle window.
Decoy Targets: Twice per battle, no more than once per battle round, in your Movement phase, select one friendly non-CHARACTER AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY model not within Engagement Range of enemy units. Remove that model without resolving rules triggered by its destruction. Remove the Callidus and set it up as close as possible to the removed model's position, outside Engagement Range of enemy units.

packages.name: Culexus
packages.text:
EXTREMIS SANCTION: Psyk-out grenades can be fired twice per battle, overriding One Shot.
Esoteric Explosives: Psyk-out grenades have Devastating Wounds.

packages.name: Eversor
packages.text:
EXTREMIS SANCTION: Overkill can be used twice per battle.
Intraneural Biotech: Once per battle, when this model is selected as the target of Heroic Intervention, reduce the CP cost of that use by 1. That use is permitted even if Heroic Intervention has already been used this phase, and does not prevent another use of it this phase.

packages.name: Vanus
packages.text:
EXTREMIS SANCTION: Ausptectre and The Cleanest Kill can each be used twice per battle. Noospheric Interloper retains its once-per-battle-round limit.
Command Interdiction: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this model. Until the end of the phase, your opponent cannot select that unit as a target of a Stratagem.

packages.name: Venenum
packages.text:
EXTREMIS SANCTION: Poison Globes can be fired twice per battle, overriding One Shot.
Lethal Distillation: Each time a poison marker placed by this model inflicts mortal wounds, it inflicts 1 additional mortal wound. A failed poison roll still inflicts no mortal wounds.

packages.name: Adamus
packages.text:
EXTREMIS SANCTION: Nemesii Grenades can be used twice per battle.
Death's Footwork: Once per battle, just after this model has fought, if it is not within Engagement Range of enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6".

rules.name: Warranted Agents
rules.text: At the start of your Command phase, select two friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY units, or three if a friendly ROGUE TRADER model is on the battlefield. Until the start of your next Command phase, those units are Warranted Agents and are eligible to shoot and start an Action despite having Advanced or Fallen Back.

enhancements.name: Privileged Charter
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Licensed Privateers
enhancements.text: Non-CHARACTER AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit. / UPGRADE This unit has Infiltrators.

stratagems.name: Unorthodox Arsenal
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot or fight.
TARGET: One friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: Select Lethal Hits or Sustained Hits 1. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by each AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM model in that unit have the selected ability. If the unit contains a ROGUE TRADER model or is currently selected as Warranted Agents, those weapons have both abilities instead.

stratagems.name: Expeditionary Landing
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Start of the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
TARGET: One friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit in Strategic Reserves.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, that unit has Deep Strike. If it contains a ROGUE TRADER model, it cannot be selected as a target of Fire Overwatch this turn.

stratagems.name: Claim the Prize
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit not within Engagement Range of enemy units.
EFFECT: That unit can make a Normal move of up to 6" and must end it within range of an objective marker outside your deployment zone. If it contains a ROGUE TRADER model, it can instead make a Normal move of up to 9" with no objective or deployment-zone endpoint requirement. Normal move restrictions still apply.

rules.name: Imperial Embarkation
rules.text: Native AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM TRANSPORT models can transport IMPERIUM INFANTRY models in addition to their normally permitted passengers. Retain their printed capacity, space costs and all other passenger exclusions.

rules.name: Boarding Assault
rules.text: In a turn in which their unit disembarked from a TRANSPORT or arrived from Reserves, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of weapons equipped by VOIDFARERS, INQUISITION or ADEPTUS ARBITES models by 1.

enhancements.name: Combat Landers
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. The bearer's unit has Deep Strike.

enhancements.name: Assault Bays
enhancements.text: Native AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM TRANSPORT unit. / UPGRADE Units disembarking from a model in this unit can be set up wholly within 6" of that model instead of wholly within 3". All other disembark restrictions apply.

stratagems.name: Breach Their Lines
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: One friendly VOIDFARERS, INQUISITION or ADEPTUS ARBITES INFANTRY unit that disembarked from a TRANSPORT or arrived from Reserves this turn.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to Wound rolls for ranged attacks made by VOIDFARERS, INQUISITION or ADEPTUS ARBITES models in that unit.

stratagems.name: Brace For Impact
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets.
TARGET: One friendly native AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM TRANSPORT unit selected as a target.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets that unit, if its Strength characteristic exceeds that unit's Toughness, subtract 1 from the Wound roll. If a model in that unit is destroyed this phase, add 1 to hazard rolls made for models disembarking from it as a result of its destruction, and their units do not become Battle-shocked as a result of those Emergency Disembark moves. This does not end any existing Battle-shock effect.

stratagems.name: Combat Extraction
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly VOIDFARERS, INQUISITION or ADEPTUS ARBITES INFANTRY unit not within Engagement Range of enemy units and wholly within 6" of a friendly native AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM TRANSPORT model.
EFFECT: That unit can embark within that TRANSPORT, provided every model is eligible and capacity permits.

rules.name: The Faithful Press On
rules.text: In your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot, if one or more models in a friendly INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or MINISTORUM unit were destroyed by those attacks, that friendly unit can make a Surge move of up to D6+1". Select its closest enemy unit or one objective marker as the destination. If an objective is selected, each model must end as close as possible to that marker; the move can end within Engagement Range only of enemy units within range of that marker. Apply all other core Surge restrictions.

enhancements.name: Fervent Orator
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Relic of the First Martyr
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. Models in the bearer's unit can ignore any or all modifiers to their Hit and Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Defiant To the End
stratagems.text:
WHEN: The Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or MINISTORUM INFANTRY unit selected as a target.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit is destroyed by a melee attack, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove it yet. After the attacking unit has fought, that destroyed model can fight, then is removed. Each destroyed model can fight only once.

stratagems.name: Unbroken Conviction
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Just after a friendly unit fails a Battle-shock test.
TARGET: That friendly INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or MINISTORUM unit.
EFFECT: Treat that test as having been passed instead. This Stratagem can target a Battle-shocked unit.

stratagems.name: Avenging Faith
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot or fight.
TARGET: One friendly INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or MINISTORUM unit below its Starting Strength.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of weapons equipped by each INQUISITION, ADEPTUS ARBITES or MINISTORUM model in that unit by 1.

rules.name: Requisitions
rules.text: One ADEPTUS TITANICUS model can be Requisitioned. Its full published points cost counts towards the army's points limit, but it does not use any shared or additional Requisition allowance. This Detachment provides its own permission to include the model; it does not require every model in the army to have IMPERIUM. Use its parent datasheet and published points.

rules.name: Sanctioned Command
rules.text: Do not apply the Striding Colossus ability of a Requisitioned ADEPTUS TITANICUS model. This applies when any Stratagem targets that model; it does not change that Stratagem's target eligibility.

rules.name: Ground Observer Network
rules.text: Each time a Requisitioned ADEPTUS TITANICUS model makes a ranged attack targeting an enemy unit visible to a friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and that attack has Ignores Cover. The Titan must still satisfy normal range and visibility requirements.

rules.name: Advance the Mandate
rules.text: Friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY units are eligible to shoot and start an Action despite having Advanced.

rules.name: God-engine Enhancements
rules.text: Requisitioned ADEPTUS TITANICUS models can be given this Detachment's ADEPTUS TITANICUS Enhancements despite not having the CHARACTER keyword. Each model can have only one Enhancement, and it counts towards the army's Enhancement limit.

enhancements.name: Legio Veteran
enhancements.text: Requisitioned ADEPTUS TITANICUS model. Once per phase, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll and one Damage roll made for the bearer.

enhancements.name: Consecrated Reactor
enhancements.text: Requisitioned ADEPTUS TITANICUS model. The bearer has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Sacristan Attendants
enhancements.text: Non-CHARACTER AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit. / UPGRADE At the end of your Command phase, select one friendly Requisitioned ADEPTUS TITANICUS model within 3" of this unit. It regains up to D3+3 lost wounds. Each Titan can benefit from Sacristan Attendants only once per turn.

enhancements.name: Mandated Garrison
enhancements.text: Non-CHARACTER AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit. / UPGRADE At the end of your Command phase, if this unit controls an objective, that objective is secured by your army.

stratagems.name: Coordinated Annihilation
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: One Requisitioned ADEPTUS TITANICUS unit.
EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by a friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM model earlier this turn. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to Wound rolls and you can re-roll Damage rolls for ranged attacks made by the Titan that target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Void Shield Surge
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets.
TARGET: One Requisitioned ADEPTUS TITANICUS unit selected as a target.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, that model has a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

stratagems.name: Colossal Advance
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a friendly unit ends an Advance move.
TARGET: That Requisitioned ADEPTUS TITANICUS unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, that unit is eligible to shoot despite having Advanced.

stratagems.name: Point-Blank Annihilation
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: One Requisitioned ADEPTUS TITANICUS unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, that model ignores Hit-roll penalties caused by units being within Engagement Range. Its Blast weapons can target enemy units within Engagement Range of it, provided those enemy units are not also within Engagement Range of another friendly unit.

stratagems.name: Exploit the Breach
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after a Requisitioned ADEPTUS TITANICUS model has shot.
TARGET: One friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit not within Engagement Range of enemy units.
EFFECT: That unit can make a Normal move of up to 6". It can still shoot and declare a charge later in the turn if otherwise eligible.

stratagems.name: Preserve the Expedition
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets.
TARGET: One friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit selected as a target.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from Wound rolls for attacks that target that unit.

rules.name: Requisitions
rules.text: An additional 250/500/750 points of IMPERIAL KNIGHTS units can be added as Requisitions in 1,000/2,000/3,000-point battles, respectively. The shared allowance can also include IMPERIAL KNIGHTS units, including CHARACTER and EPIC HERO units. These allowances replace the normal Knight allied-unit limits. Use parent datasheets and published points.

rules.name: Oaths of Mutual Service
rules.text: Each time a Requisitioned IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model attacks an enemy unit hit by a friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM model earlier that turn, you can re-roll Hit rolls and Wound rolls of 1. Each time a friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM model attacks an enemy unit hit by a Requisitioned IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model earlier that turn, add 1 to the Wound roll.

rules.name: Household Bonds
rules.text: Requisitioned IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models can use their Bondsman abilities, following the parent rules for those abilities.

rules.name: Household Enhancements
rules.text: Requisitioned IMPERIAL KNIGHTS CHARACTER models can be given this Detachment's IMPERIAL KNIGHTS Enhancements, excluding EPIC HERO models. Each model can have only one Enhancement.

enhancements.name: Relic Ion Projector
enhancements.text: Requisitioned IMPERIAL KNIGHTS CHARACTER model. Once per battle round, just after the bearer fails a saving throw, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

enhancements.name: Questing Pennant
enhancements.text: Requisitioned IMPERIAL KNIGHTS CHARACTER model. Add 2" to the bearer's Move characteristic and add 1 to Charge rolls made for its unit.

enhancements.name: Herald of Concord
enhancements.text: AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER model. You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Sacristan Auxilia
enhancements.text: Non-CHARACTER AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit. / UPGRADE At the end of your Command phase, select one friendly Requisitioned IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model within 3" of this unit. It regains up to 3 lost wounds. Each Knight can benefit from Sacristan Auxilia only once per turn.

stratagems.name: Fulfil the Oath
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly unit is selected to shoot or fight.
TARGET: One Requisitioned IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of weapons equipped by each IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model in that unit by 1.

stratagems.name: Noble Intercession
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent's Charge phase.
TARGET: One Requisitioned IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit eligible to declare a charge against an enemy unit within 12" that is within Engagement Range of a friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: That Knight unit can declare a charge against that enemy unit. You can re-roll its Charge roll. It does not receive a Charge bonus this turn.

stratagems.name: Honoured Advance
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a friendly unit ends an Advance or Fall Back move.
TARGET: That Requisitioned IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge despite having Advanced or Fallen Back.

stratagems.name: Ion Screen
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets.
TARGET: One Requisitioned IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit selected as a target.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

stratagems.name: March of the Household
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a friendly unit ends an Advance move.
TARGET: That friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge despite having Advanced.

stratagems.name: A Knight's Vengeance
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot and destroyed a friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit.
TARGET: One Requisitioned IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit eligible to shoot.
EFFECT: That Knight unit can shoot with one ranged weapon as if it were your Shooting phase, targeting only that enemy unit and following normal targeting restrictions.

references.name: Imperial Authority
references.text:
Imperial Authority: Start the battle with 2 Authority Points (AP). At the start
of each of your Command phases, gain 1 AP. There is no maximum number
of AP you can store.
Priority Target: At the start of your Command phase, select one enemy unit
on the battlefield to be your Priority Target, replacing your previous selection.
Once per battle round, when your Priority Target is destroyed, gain 1 AP.
Priority Site: At the start of your turn, select one objective marker outside
your deployment zone that you do not control to be your Priority Site,
replacing your previous selection. Once per battle round, at the end of your
turn, if you control your Priority Site, gain 1 AP. If there is no eligible marker
when you would select one, retain your current Priority Site, if any.
Imperial Sanction: An Imperial Sanction is a datasheet ability. Its entry gives
its AP cost, timing, target, effect and use limit. Spend the stated AP when you
activate it, after checking that its target is eligible. You cannot activate it if
you cannot pay its cost.
Imperial Strategist: If your Warlord has this ability, gain 1 CP at the start of
each battle round.

references.name: Imperial Requisitions
references.text:
Requisition Allowance: Up to 25% of the army's points limit can be spent on
the eligible Requisitioned units listed here: 250 points at 1,000 points, 500 at
2,000 points, or 750 at 3,000 points. Additional allowances granted by
selected Detachments are added to this shared allowance and can be spent
only on their specified faction. The shared allowance remains available for
any eligible Requisitioned faction.
Separate Command: Use the selected unit's parent datasheet. Requisitioned
units do not gain Agents of the Imperium army or detachment rules, or their
parent faction army rule, unless another rule explicitly grants access. An
attached Inquisitor does not change this.
ADEPTA SORORITAS, GREY KNIGHTS and DEATHWATCH are Requisitions,
not native units. CHARACTER units are excluded unless an entry or
Detachment expressly permits them. IMPERIAL KNIGHTS and ADEPTUS
TITANICUS use the explicit permissions in Oathsworn Lance and God-Engine
Mandate when those Detachments are selected.

Requisitioned identity: Requisitioned models gain REQUISITIONED as a
bookkeeping keyword, in addition to their printed keywords. They retain their
original Faction keywords and use their parent datasheets and published
points. They do not automatically receive either faction's army rules. An
express rule, such as Household Bonds, can grant an exception.

references.name: Authority Expenditures
references.text:
Priority Target Elimination - 1 AP: When: Start of your Shooting phase or the
Fight phase. Target: One friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit that is
eligible to shoot or fight in that phase, as appropriate. Effect: Until the end of
the phase, add 1 to Wound rolls for attacks made by models in that unit that
target your Priority Target.
Operational Momentum - 1 AP: When: Your Movement phase, just after a
friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit ends an Advance move.
Target: That unit. Effect: Until the end of the turn, that Advance move does
not prevent that unit from being eligible to shoot or start an Action. Resolve
shooting and Actions at their normal times. Other eligibility restrictions still
apply.
Field Protection - 1 AP: When: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight
phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets. Target: One friendly
AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit selected as the target of one or more of
those attacks. Effect: Until the end of the phase, models in that unit have Feel
No Pain 5+.
Pay AP each time an option is used. An effect that is already active is not
increased by applying the same option again. Individual datasheet Sanctions
retain their own use limits.

references.name: Transport and Keyword Conventions
references.text:
Faction and branch keywords: Every native unit and native model in this book
has the AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM faction keyword. Native units also have
their printed branch keyword: ADEPTUS ARBITES, ASSASSINORUM,
INQUISITION, VOIDFARERS or MINISTORUM. Requisitioned units do not gain
these keywords. A Rogue Trader retainer has only the model keywords
printed for it, plus AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM and VOIDFARERS; it does not
gain CHARACTER merely by joining the household.
Weapon conventions: CLOSE-QUARTERS replaces the earlier weapon ability
PISTOL; weapon names are unchanged. BLAST still prevents attacks against
engaged targets unless an explicit rule removes that restriction. A
keyword-restricted critical-hit ability applies only against the named target
category. Hunter weapon profiles can target only MONSTER or VEHICLE
units.
Objective Secured: At the end of your Command phase, if this unit controls
an objective, that objective is secured by your army.
Mixed-model transports: Apply the transport's printed eligibility first, then
count occupied spaces. Suppression Automata cannot embark unless a
transport expressly permits them. Terminator-armoured Inquisitors cannot
embark in the Chimera. Bulwark Combat Servitors occupy two spaces each;
Rogue Trader Astartes and Stealth Suit retainers occupy two; Ogryn Boarders
and Shipbreaker Exosuits occupy three where permitted.
Psychic abilities: Use Sanctioned Psykana on the Sanctioned Psykana
reference for Psychic Abilities and Psychic Rolls. Psychic weapon attacks do
not consume Psychic Levels. A Psychic-tagged Sanction remains an AP
ability unless its own entry also assigns a Psychic Level and requires a
Psychic Roll.
Leader and Support: Follow the 11e core rules for Leader and Support, using
each datasheet's eligible units. Support is a separate attachment permission
and does not grant permission to attach an additional Leader. Inquisitorial
eligibility is consolidated on the Command and Retinue Attachments
reference.
Use allowances: Returning a destroyed model to its unit does not refresh
spent once-per-battle abilities or One Shot weapons. Track the same model's
and unit's spent allowances.
Rule references: Within Engagement Range, within range of an objective
marker, eligible to shoot or fight, and legal setup all use the 11e core rules. A
permission to enter or return from Reserves changes setup restrictions only
where it explicitly says so. A repeated copy of a named effect does not stack
with itself.

references.name: Universal Inquisitorial Writs
references.text:
Each generic full Inquisitor with Inquisitorial Writ selects one of these Writs
or one Writ unlocked by a selected Ordo Detachment. Each named Writ can
be selected only once across the army. Every selected Writ is an Imperial
Sanction available to its bearer.
IMPERIAL SANCTION / Ordo Xenos - Writ of Xenocide: Cost: 1 AP. When:
Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly unit is selected to
shoot or fight. Target: That friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit, if it is
within 12" of this model. Effect: Select Lethal Hits or Sustained Hits 1. Until
the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the
selected ability when targeting your Priority Target. Limit: Once per battle
round for this model.
IMPERIAL SANCTION / Ordo Hereticus - Writ of Condemnation: Cost: 1 AP.
When: End of your Shooting phase. Target: One enemy unit within 18" of and
visible to this model that was hit by a friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM
attack this phase. Effect: That unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting
1 from the result. If it fails, it suffers D3 mortal wounds. Limit: Once per
battle round for this model.
IMPERIAL SANCTION / Ordo Malleus - Writ of Abjuration: Cost: 2 AP. When:
Start of your opponent's Movement phase. Target: One friendly AGENTS OF
THE IMPERIUM unit within 12" of this model. Effect: Until the end of the turn,
models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save, and enemy units being set up
from Reserves cannot be set up within 12" of it. Limit: Once per battle round
for this model.
Lord's Mandate discounts a qualifying Sanction; it does not grant an
additional Writ.

references.name: Sanctioned Psykana
references.text:
Sanctioned Psykana (Psyker Level X): This model has PSYKER and can use
the Psychic Abilities listed for it. In each battle round, the combined Psychic
Levels of the abilities it uses cannot exceed X. Declare the ability and select
any required targets, then make one Psychic Roll (D6). On a 1, this model's
unit becomes Battle-shocked; resolve the ability even if this happens. Its
Psychic Level is spent regardless of the result.
A Battle-shocked unit cannot initiate these Psychic Abilities. Psychic weapon
attacks do not consume Psychic Levels. Psychic Gifts and Blessed Wardings
are mutually exclusive where the datasheet says so.
Prescience - Psychic Level 1: When: Start of your Shooting phase. After
making a Psychic Roll, until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Hit rolls of 1
for ranged attacks made by models in this unit.
Psychic Barrier - Psychic Level 1: When: Start of your opponent's Shooting
phase. After making a Psychic Roll, until the end of the phase, models in this
unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

references.name: Psychic Gifts
references.text:
Each generic Inquisitor variant with Psychic Gifts knows Prescience, Psychic
Barrier and its unique power below. All use the Psychic Roll and battle-round
level budget in Sanctioned Psykana.
Mental Interrogation - Level 1 / Inquisitor: When: Start of your Shooting
phase. Target: One enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this model. After
making a Psychic Roll, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped
by friendly INQUISITION models have Ignores Cover when targeting that
enemy unit.
Psychometric Survey - Level 1 / High Interrogator: When: Start of your
Command phase. Target: One objective marker within 18" of this model.
After making a Psychic Roll, until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Objective
Control characteristic of models in this unit while they are within range of that
marker.
Psychic Onslaught - Level 1 / Power Armour: When: The Fight phase, when
this unit is selected to fight. After making a Psychic Roll, until the end of the
phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of this model's melee
weapons by 1.
Displacement Field - Level 1 / Terminator Armour: When: Start of your
opponent's Shooting phase, if this unit was set up using Deep Strike during
the previous turn. After making a Psychic Roll, until the end of the phase,
subtract 1 from Hit rolls for ranged attacks targeting this unit.
Dominion of the Mind - Level 2 / Inquisitor Lord: When: Start of your
Shooting phase. Target: One friendly IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit within 12" of
this model. After making a Psychic Roll, until the end of the phase, you can
re-roll Hit and Wound rolls of 1 for that unit's ranged attacks that target your
Priority Target.

references.name: Rogue Trader Household
references.text:
Rogue Trader household: Base Rogue Trader: 55 points. Add 0-8 different
retainers at their individual costs. Each named retainer may be selected at
most once. Only one Rogue Trader unit may be included in an army. These
models form one unit and one datasheet selection; retainers are neither
separate units nor Requisitions.
Active models and granted effects: A retainer can use or grant its printed
ability only while that model remains in this unit on the battlefield. Once an
ability has resolved, any effect with an explicit duration lasts for that duration
unless its wording requires the bearer to remain. An ongoing while-present
effect ends when its model leaves or is destroyed.
Keywords and psychic models: Human and Astartes retainers have
INFANTRY, RETAINER, IMPERIUM and VOIDFARERS. Xenos retainers instead
have INFANTRY, RETAINER, SANCTIONED XENOS and VOIDFARERS. All have
AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM. The Rogue Trader alone has CHARACTER; the
normal unit keyword rules still apply. Way Seeker and Navigator have PSYKER
and Sanctioned Psykana at their printed level. The Stealth Suit also has FLY
and BATTLESUIT.
Mixed Toughness and capacity: Use Motley Household on the Rogue Trader
datasheet. Individual models retain their own saves and Wounds. Astartes
and Stealth Suit retainers occupy two transport spaces; other retainers
occupy one unless expressly stated otherwise.
Example: Rogue Trader + Way Seeker + Stealth Suit + Blackshield + Kroot +
Tech-Adept + Rejuvenat + Seneschal + Salamander = 225 points and nine
models.

references.name: Detachment Selection
references.text:
Detachment Points: Select Detachments within the Detachment Points
allowance for the battle size, following the core army-building rules. A 3DP
Detachment offers two Force Dispositions; a 2DP or 1DP Detachment offers
one. Select one available Force Disposition for the army.
Unique: ORDO: Each Ordo Detachment in this book has Unique: ORDO. An
army can include only one Detachment with that tag. The non-Ordo branch
Detachments, God-Engine Mandate and Oathsworn Lance do not have that
tag.
Ordo Writs: An INQUISITOR model with Inquisitorial Writ can select one Writ
unlocked by the selected Ordo Detachment instead of a universal Writ. It
gains that Ordo keyword. This does not grant an additional Writ or add Writ
selection to an EPIC HERO datasheet that lacks it.
Enhancements and Upgrades: Follow the core Enhancement limits. Unless
expressly permitted, EPIC HERO models cannot receive Enhancements and a
model can receive only one. Each ordinary Enhancement can be selected only
once. An Enhancement with Upgrade can be given to up to three different
eligible non-CHARACTER units as one Enhancement selection; pay its points
for each unit. No unit can receive multiple copies of the same Upgrade.
Rules recipients: Native units use AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM plus their
branch keyword. Requisitioned models benefit only where expressly named or
given a qualifying Ordo keyword. A unit-targeted move or defensive effect
applies to the whole selected unit. A model-targeted weapon bonus applies
only to the models named.
Additional Requisitions: Add each selected Detachment's specified
allowance to the shared allowance. For example, in a 2,000-point army
Purgation Force adds 500 points of Sororitas: the result can be 1,000 points
of Sororitas, or 500 points of Sororitas plus 500 points of another eligible
Requisitioned faction.
